formal_statement.interpretation: The polynomial is (a^2+b^2+2c^2)/2-[2hc+(2h+h^2)b]^2. The bracketed expression is the proposed change in the quadratic measurement of the symmetric matrix [[a,c],[c,b]] when (1,1) becomes (1,1+h). The verifier certifies the formal inequality only. Its combination with r08 requires separately checking this measurement identity and the shared perturbation model.

proposal_claim_unverified: For a symmetric lift difference [[a,c],[c,b]], perturbing the sensing vector (1,1) to (1,1+h), with |h|<=1/6, changes its intensity difference by an error whose square is at most half the squared Frobenius norm of the lift difference.
